infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Eva transcribes your speech on-device; audio never leaves this iPhone.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Eva listens for your voice so you can talk to her hands-free.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Eva checks on this iPhone whether someone is at the desk, keeping no images, and takes a photo only after asking you out loud and hearing you agree.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Eva uses your location only to know which town she is in. Only the town is kept, never your exact location.
